dedupe_keys.name: plantoact task 2 1 hourly profiles heating and cooling demand

description: The PLANtoACT project publishes normalised hourly building heating and cooling demand profiles for Lombardia, Alba, Oberland, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes and the Porto Metropolitan Area. The profiles use Renewables.ninja weather and the demand_ninja building-demand model, averaged over regional MERRA-2 grid points for 2020–2024. Final profiles contain 8,784 hourly values on a leap-year calendar. CSV and text profiles accompany annual degree-hour integrals, intermediate series and regional boundary shapefiles. Normalisation preserves the five-year mean degree-hour integral through a correction applied to the latest year. The source gives energy-system simulations, capacity expansion and sector-coupling studies as intended applications. Zenodo provides access and links a generation-script repository. Matteo Giacomo Prina of Accademia Europea deposited six ZIP archives, available free under CC BY 4.0. Related PLANtoACT building-stock records describe a separate Task 2.2 product. A limitation is that the profiles are modelled and dimensionless; they are not measured absolute regional energy consumption.
